Paint one complete children's picture-book scene with three individual friends gathered around a yellow scarf on the garden grass. Re-pose the three individuals in Image 1: each reference individual becomes exactly one of the three bodies in this new scene. Use the reference for identity, clothing and relative physical size; replace its standing lineup and pale portrait backgrounds with this garden scene.

Pip, the left reference character, is the charcoal-grey and white penguin in red rubber boots. His feathered neck and shoulders are bare because his scarf is now on the grass. This one penguin holds the yellow knitted scarf flat on the grass.
Momo, the middle reference character, is the slender light-brown monkey with large expressive eyes, one long curled tail, a teal vest and brown leather sandals. This one monkey bends forward, tilting a clear cylindrical glass honey jar so a thick golden stream lands on the scarf Pip is holding. His bent pouring pose replaces his standing reference pose.
Suki, the right reference character, is the greyish-brown shaggy sloth with dark almond eyes, a gentle smile, a pale pink apron with a front pocket and purple slippers. This one sloth stands nearby watching the honey land on the scarf.

The single scarf is long golden-yellow wool with chunky cable knitting and short matching fringe tassels at both ends. It lies naturally on the grass and is soaked in golden honey. The jar contains viscous golden honey. Show the shared action clearly, with the stream connecting the tilted jar to the scarf.

Keep their canonical body sizes through their new poses: Pip is 60 cm tall, Momo 50 cm, Suki 45 cm. Pip is about 1.2 times Momo's standing height and 1.3 times Suki's. Three characters total: one penguin, one monkey, one sloth, each with its own separate natural anatomy. The same three friends perform all the actions in this single moment.

Warm hand-painted children's book illustration, soft gouache and coloured-pencil texture, clear shapes, expressive natural poses, gentle lighting. Warm pastel palette: butter-yellow, mint-green, soft coral and shimmering iridescent tones. Full-bleed garden artwork without lettering or portrait panels.
